limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Classical Weyl-algebra automorphism structure due to Dixmier and Makar-Limanov is prior art. The new claim is restricted to the first-order-in-q stratum and its explicit isotropy trichotomy; higher q-degree elements remain open. Equivalent implicit coverage in older Weyl-algebra or polynomial-automorphism literature remains a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: An exact isotropy classification for first-order elements a(p)q+b(p) in the first Weyl algebra, yielding an affirmative partial answer to the open isotropy criterion beyond the locally finite case.
record_title: First-order Weyl elements satisfy the isotropy criterion beyond local finiteness
